$comment: Text pool for the Persecuted Church prayer category.
requests: Courage for believers who face danger for their faith.
Praying for brothers and sisters around the world who lose their jobs or their homes because they follow Jesus. May God provide for every need and give them a joy that cannot be taken away.
Lifting up pastors who have to lead their churches in secret. Give them wisdom, protect their families, and let them know the global church has not forgotten them.
For new believers whose families have turned against them for choosing Christ. Pray they find a family of faith that holds them close.

Our small group has been reading about Christians who are in prison for their faith. It is humbling. We are praying for their strength, their health, and for them to sense God's presence right where they are.
For the children of persecuted believers. Pray for their safety, for their schooling, and that they grow up loving Jesus even when it costs their families so much.
Asking God to protect the Bibles and resources being carried to places where they are hard to get. Keep the people who carry them safe.

I cannot stop thinking about believers who meet in homes with the curtains closed and sing quietly so the neighbors will not hear. We gather here every Sunday so freely and I take it for granted. Lord, give them courage and joy, protect them from harm, and let their faith shine so brightly that others are drawn to You. Help us remember them more than once a year.
Remembering Christian families who have had to leave everything behind and start over somewhere new. Provide homes, work, and kind neighbors.
Joy and endurance for the suffering church.
details: Remember them that are in bonds, as bound with them (Hebrews 13:3, KJV). That verse has been on my mind.
They are part of our family in Christ, even if we never meet them on this side of heaven.
I may never know the outcome, but I know God hears every prayer for His people.
Pray that they would also be able to forgive and love the people who oppose them.
Our family prays for them at dinner, and it has changed how we see our own freedom.
answers: We heard encouraging news this month about believers standing strong and churches still growing. Thank you for praying.
Thank you for remembering the persecuted church. Reports say they feel the prayers of believers around the world.
God is faithful. Even in hard places, the church is still growing and still singing.
Grateful for everyone who prays for our brothers and sisters. Please keep lifting them up.
